title: mlconf-2026-travel-admin-scratchpad
content:
MLCONF 2026 — travel & admin scratchpad
Owner: Jordan Kim (working notes)
Status: working draft for travel reimbursements + vendor contacts

Top priorities (before travel):
- Confirm flight + hotel + airport transfer by 2026-04-10. If anything changes, update calendar and expenses folder.
- Submit pre-approval for booth materials (EXP-MLCONF-2026-BOOTH) to finance by 2026-04-05.
- Print travel itinerary and VAT receipts cheat-sheet.

Flights:
- Outbound: SFO -> JFK, United UA 1943, depart 2026-04-20 08:15, arrive 12:45. (Booked on corporate card)
- Return: JFK -> SFO, United UA 1982, depart 2026-04-23 17:30, arrive 21:10.
Notes: check in 24h prior, seat change request? try to get bulkhead/extra legroom. Short-hop bag policy — receipts needed for reimbursements.

Hotel:
- Hilton Midtown Manhattan (block under Redwood Inference)
- Reservation name: Redwood Inference / Jordan Kim (room & tax covered by company)
- Check-in: 2026-04-20; check-out: 2026-04-24
- Address & phone: 1335 6th Ave, New York, NY — Front desk: +1-212-xxx-xxxx
- Note: get itemized folio at check-out for meals/incidentals to attach to expense report.

Airport transfer:
- Ground vendor (recommended): Midtown Shuttle Co. — contact: Ana Ruiz, ana@midtownshuttle.co, +1-646-555-0199
- Backup: Lyft/Uber (use Redwood corporate account + receipts)

Booth & A/V logistics (booth 12):
- Booth lead: Jamie Cho (onsite) — Slack: @jamiecho
- A/V vendor: SoundWorks Events — contact: Kevin Lee, kevin@soundworks.io, +1-347-555-1022
  - Audio check window: 2026-04-20 14:00–16:00 (schedule with Kevin)
  - Confirm HDMI adapter + backup laptop and audio patch cable.
- Shipping: crates to arrive by 2026-04-19. Coordination with venue receiving: Venue Receiving Desk (email: receiving@mlconfvenue.com). Include crate inventory and return label.
- Furniture rental: EventFurnish — order reference EF-7782 (already placed).

Vendors & contacts (quick):
- Catering for small booth meetup: CityBites Catering — contact: Mira Patel, mira@citybites.com, +1-212-555-1414. Order for 30 people, light snacks (gluten-free options). Delivery window: 2026-04-21 10:30–11:30.
- Printing / badges: FastPrint NY — order PR-MLCONF-22, contact: Omar Reyes, omar@fastprintny.com, +1-718-555-3003. Confirm final badge list by 2026-04-08.

Expense reminders (finance policy + receipts):
- Attach itemized receipts for ALL meals, taxis, rideshares, and hotel incidentals. Credit card receipts alone are not sufficient — need merchant itemization for VAT.
- Per diem: US domestic — use actuals for meals > $75/day with receipts; otherwise use standard per diem if auto-approved by manager.
- Currency conversions: use Concur/Expensify conversion at date of charge; include screenshot of conversion if paying in non-USD.
- Expense codes: EXP-MLCONF-2026 (travel + lodging), EXP-MLCONF-2026-BOOTH (booth materials/shipping), EXP-MKT-MLCONF (marketing collateral). Put code in the expense memo field.
- Submit expense report within 10 business days after return (target by 2026-04-10). Tag Jamie/Finance on any ambiguous items.

Reimbursement checklist:
- [ ] Flight receipt + itinerary (e-ticket PDF)
- [ ] Hotel folio (itemized)
- [ ] Ground transfer receipts (Ana Ruiz invoice or rideshare receipts)
- [ ] Booth shipping invoice + proof of delivery
- [ ] Catering invoice with tax info
- [ ] Badge order invoice
- [ ] Any client/partner dinners — include attendee list and business purpose

Onsite agenda / people to meet:
- 2026-04-21, 09:00 — Booth setup final walkthrough with A/V
- 2026-04-21, 12:30 — Panel: "Optimizing LLM inference at scale" (Alex Rivera presenting) — confirm mic + clicker
- 2026-04-22, 10:30 — Partner meetup w/ OpenInfra (Booth 30) — pre-send deck and business cards

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Ask Ops for spare HDMI-to-DisplayPort adapters.
- Send final attendee list to FastPrint by 2026-04-08.
- Confirm dietary restrictions for catering (gluten-free + vegetarian).
- Create a folder: Drive > shared_drives/company/events/mlconf-2026/receipts (move receipts daily).
- Remind team to put "EXP-MLCONF-2026" in Concur memo field.

Post-travel follow-up:
- Upload all receipts and expenses to Concur, tag with project code.
- Quick retro: what worked (shipping timing, A/V), what to improve (badge pickup queue, signage visibility).
- Save vendor invoices to Confluence page: CONFLUENCE-MLCONF-2026-VENDORS for future reuse.

Loose notes & traces (handy links):
- Conference site: https://mlconf2026.example.com (agenda + exhibitor info)
- Venue receiving rules: doc-id-VENUE-RECEIVING (put in Confluence)
- Redwood event Slack channel: #events-mlconf-2026

Random: bring a small multi-plug + power strip for booth (hotel allows). Pack spare business cards and a USB-C dongle for demos.

End of scratchpad.
